# Vendored from picocalc-text-starter

*README.MD file mostly generated by Anthropic's Claude AI because Thomas Dzubin hates documenting code.  LOL*

`lcd.c`, `lcd.h`, `font.h`, `font-8x10.c`, `southbridge.c`, `southbridge.h`,
`keyboard.h`, `audio.c`, `audio.h`, and `audio.pio` are copied unmodified from
[picocalc-text-starter](https://github.com/) by **Blair Leduc** (see
`LICENSE-picocalc-text-starter.txt`) - the minimal subset needed to drive
the PicoCalc's ST7789P LCD (`lcd_init`, `lcd_solid_rectangle`, `lcd_blit`)
and read its keyboard (`sb_init`, `sb_read_keyboard`; `keyboard.h` is
included only for its `KEY_STATE_*` constants - the higher-level
`keyboard.c` wrapper itself isn't vendored, same as every other PicoCalc
project on this machine: reading `sb_read_keyboard()` directly avoids a
background poll timer racing the game's own input handling), and play a
short beep on an illegal move attempt (`audio_play_sound_blocking`).
Everything else from that project (SD card, the `keyboard.c` wrapper,
5x10 font) was left out.

**Treat this folder as read-only.** If the LCD driver needs a change,
make it in the original `picocalc-text-starter` project and re-copy these
four files, rather than editing the copies here.
